note: Axis 3 (Liquidity & Exit), single producer. This payload contains measured exit evidence only and does not author a risk score. Pool TVL, wrapper TVL, and Stability Pool deposits are not substituted for executable depth.

depth.depth_usd_semantics: lower_bound_of_bracket: a size that cleared the threshold, never the crossing itself. Read `bracket` for the located range and `bracket.meets_precision_obligation` for whether it is within 1% of midpoint; a false there with a wide bracket means depth_usd may understate the crossing by the bracket's width.

baseline_rung.quote_expiry_basis: KyberSwap's route response supplies a generation timestamp but no validity deadline. The route is indicative until transaction calldata is built; re-quote immediately before execution.

rung_set.termination_note: Ascending the decade grid stopped at the first rung past the threshold. A SHORT LADDER IS THE ANSWER, NOT A GAP: continuing upward buys nothing once the crossing is bracketed.

depth.slippage_convention: Signed average execution-rate return minus the lowest valid successful decade-rung return (>= $1,000); standing spread and gas separate; not an adjacent-rung derivative.
depth.basis: The -200bps crossing is BRACKETED between 1,000,000 (clears at -4.05bps) and 10,000,000 (-3764.99bps). Published figure is the last rung that cleared, so true depth sits inside the bracket and above what is shown.

quote.method: KyberSwap GET /api/v1/routes exact-input BOLD -> USDC; the router discovers and split-optimises Curve, Uniswap V3/V4, and any other executable venues at each size
quote.resolution: Both tokens are exact addresses. Returned route venues are enumerated from router responses, never selected by ticker or guessed pool keys.

failure_reporting.note: A failed rung carries `failure_kind` and `http_status`. `no_route_found` is a finding ABOUT THE ASSET; every other kind is our instrument failing, and the two must not be read as the same claim.

retry_policy.failure_semantics: A transient upstream failure becomes quote_failed only after all attempts fail. no_route_found is not retried because it is a venue finding. Failures are never interpolated or treated as zero liquidity.

quote.reference_rule: lowest valid successful decade rung >= $1,000; no separate micro probe

venue_enumeration.method: union of address-keyed router routes returned across tested sizes

enumeration.source: Aggregator-enumerated Ethereum venue set, resolved by the live BOLD contract address and deduplicated by underlying swap pool
enumeration.completeness: Twenty Ethereum pools were enumerated. The seven named venues are listed individually; thirteen further pools jointly represented less than $30K TVL and are summarized as one row. LP-token wrappers and Liquity Stability Pools are excluded from swap liquidity.
enumeration.live_venue_count_basis: Derived from venues[].is_live. The per-venue field is the single source; this integer is a convenience and cannot disagree with it. ⚠️ 2 venue(s) carry no established verdict, so this is a FLOOR of confirmed-live venues, not a total. An unestablished venue is UNKNOWN, not dead.
